title: [Master] - Slice 640778: [Sustainability] Sustainability Entries should be more easy to find like other entries across BC
summary: Sustainability entries can now be found more easily through a Find Entries action on the Sustainability Ledger Entries page and new Sustainability Value Entries actions on Item Card and Item List pages.
key_points: Find entries (Navigate) action with Ctrl+Alt+Q shortcut added to the Sustainability Ledger Entries page
The Find entries action matches the pattern already used on the Sustainability Value Entries page
Sustainability Value Entries action added to the Item Card under Related, History, Entries, filtered by Item No.
The same action added to the Item List page
Both item actions are visible only when Item Emissions is enabled in Sustainability Setup
quote: Find Entries on Sustainability Ledger Entries page
